matches.title: Galatasaray vs Venezia
matches.description: Watch Galatasaray vs Venezia highlights and goals from Friendly on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on July 27, 2026. The friendly clash between Galatasaray and Venezia served as a high-stakes preparation match for both clubs as they looked to fine-tune their squads for the upcoming season. Fans gathered to witness an intriguing tactical battle between the Turkish giants and the ambitious Italian side. A Tight Affair Under the Summer Sun Taking place on July 27, 2026 , the match began with both sides displaying a cautious approach, prioritizing defensive shape over all-out attack. Galatasaray controlled much of the possession in the early stages, searching for gaps in a disciplined Venezia backline. However, clear-cut chances were hard to come by, and the first hour of play was characterized by intense midfield duels and tactical maneuvering that left the deadlock unbroken. Venezia’s Late Surge Decides the Tie The momentum shifted dramatically in the 71st minute when J. Yeboah found the back of the net to give Venezia the lead. This goal acted as a catalyst for a frantic period of play. Just four minutes later, in the 75th minute, the referee pointed to the spot, awarding the visitors a penalty. L. Lauberbach stepped up and calmly converted, doubling the advantage and leaving the hosts reeling. As the game entered stoppage time, Galatasaray pushed forward in a desperate attempt to find a lifeline. Instead, they were caught out once more. In the 90+2nd minute, L. Lauberbach struck again to secure his brace and round off a clinical performance for Venezia , underlining their superior finishing in a game of fine margins.
